$meta.dragon_decision: Gold-hued Kali dragon approved on wallpaper-default, bottom-right corner, 64px, fill trace.gold.dim #8A6318. The mark itself is NOT redrawn by design — the build recolors the upstream Kali SVG. Source: /usr/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps/kali-menu.svg (package kali-menu) or kali-dragon.svg from kali-themes. Recolor by overriding every fill/stroke to #8A6318; do not outline, plate, or rotate.
$meta.purple_decision: DECLINED — CZD gold only. accent.purple.* are aliases to the gold ramp so consumers can reference the key without introducing a second hue. Do not add purple without a new approval.
extensions_flagged: font.ui (Archivo promoted from display-only to UI body role)
surface.overlay (CZD surface-warm reassigned to the menu/overlay plane)

base.use: desktop root, GRUB field, window background, terminal background

raised.use: panel, SDDM card, Calamares sidebar, welcome-app panes

overlay.use: Kickoff menu, tooltips, popups, context menus

inset.use: input field wells, list backgrounds, full-bleed vignette core

gold.use: primary trace stroke, brand gold, all hairlines at alpha

gold.dim.use: background trace lattice, deep display type, fold ticks

gold.surge.use: the electricity value — surge head, hover, peak emphasis. Rationed.

gold.deep.use: barely-there trace fills, far-field circuit density

purple.use: NOT USED. Reserved key. Renders as gold.

purple.dim.use: NOT USED. Reserved key. Renders as gold.dim.

secondary.use: body copy, menu items, mono captions

disabled.use: disabled controls only — never body text

success.use: ok/verified, apt success, ANSI green anchor

warning.use: caution — brand gold serves as warning; ANSI yellow anchor

error.use: login failed, apt error, ANSI red anchor

bg.emphasis.use: the single loudest element per screen — current item, NOW chip, default button

ui.use: Plasma UI, window titles, welcome app, Calamares

display.use: wordmarks, Plymouth, GRUB title, wallpaper headline

font.substitutions: None required. Both CZD families are OFL Google Fonts releases and are redistributable inside the ISO.

radius.note: CZD specifies border-radius: 0 everywhere. Plasma widgets that cannot be squared (Breeze scrollbar caps) are left at theme default rather than given a CZD radius.

rule.bold.use: page caps, section caps, QR blocks

geometry.gradient: none — except the wallpaper vignette and the trace surge falloff, which are luminance-only ramps of a single hue

event.note: Respin edit 01 lives here. generate.py derives the display date line (FRI OCT 02 – SAT OCT 03, 2026) from start/end; never hand-write it elsewhere.

ansi.$note: Batch 07 instrument palette. The one sanctioned exception to one hue, scoped to terminals and the Wireshark packet list only. Derived from the gold ramp by OKLCH hue rotation at L≈0.58 (normal) and L≈0.70 (bright), chroma ≤ 0.06. Ratios are on #050505. Extension: this section was on the plate, not in the frozen 1.0.0 map.
